title: Band squat
steps: Stand on the middle of the band with your feet hip-width apart.
Hold one end in each hand at your shoulders.
Bend your knees and sit your hips back, keeping your chest up.
Stand back up and squeeze your glutes.
Do 2 sets of 10, resting between sets.
Keep a chair behind you if you want something to aim for.
mistakes: Lifting your heels off the floor.
